dataset: Full RAW-FABRID V1, 19852 patches, verified publisher checksum
split: Seven publisher fabric-origin IDs joined through HighRes metadata; one frozen origin/source/duplicate split, seed 42. These IDs are not verified physical rolls.
primary_metric: Defect-class F2; threshold chosen on validation only

refinement.rule: Repeat the best of the 20 validation-selected configurations for up to 12 epochs, seed 42; select between all 21 by the same validation F2/AP/parameter tie-break. No test access.

classical_search.fitting: Train-only StandardScaler; LinearSVC for linear kernel and SVC for RBF; no test use

xai.sample: At most nine per TP/FN/FP/TN category, prefer distinct source images then deterministic filename order
xai.occlusion: Fixed 10 percent high/low/random mean fill, seed 42
xai.primary_predictions: All validation/test examples remain in metrics

budget_reason: CPU-only environment with eight allocated cores. Full-data screening followed by a predeclared longer selected-model refinement; modest width limits capacity with only four publisher fabric-origin training groups. Short-search conclusions are explicitly limited to early training behaviour. No dataset or held-out subset is substituted.

pre_test_execution_amendments.reason: Train/validation-only hardware profiling and shared-core contention. No test data or partial-prompt metrics used. ANN training stays float32/eight threads; per-image normalisation is bit-identical NumPy arithmetic.
